theme: An open day in Dubrovnik before Saturday's boarding.
greeting: The calendar's clear, Dan — but this is the last real stretch of dry land before the charter, and a short list of trip-prep wants closing before you board Saturday and lose signal.

needsAttention.title: Confirm boarding with the Nautilus instructor
needsAttention.detail: You still need the exact time and place for Saturday's boarding and the return airport transfer, both far easier to pin down from shore than from the water. In Todoist since Sept 5.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat transfers and checkout
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer, the early bag hold before 3 PM check-in, and the pre-dawn Sept 20 checkout all have to be arranged from land before Saturday. The hotel's booked; these three aren't.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 20-Oct 5 rental car
needsAttention.detail: No longer a hedge in Todoist: the Pathfinder can't reach Florida before Oct 18, so this cycle needs the full-size SUV out of TPA. You land jet-lagged on a Sunday, so don't arrive without it booked.

needsAttention.title: Close the St Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: Two nights, Sept 20-21, before the kids' Sept 22 pickup still need lodging, and the Sept 27-Oct 5 Airbnb was left pending host confirmation, worth checking it converted rather than quietly expired.

flagged.title: A sitter applied on Care.com
flagged.detail: Emily B. applied to your posted job, waiting whenever you want to look at candidates.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos: NYT Cooking, Responsible Investor, ExecThread's Labor Day sale, and a couple of keep-in-touch nudges.
inbox.clear: Nothing personal is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Grilled quail with braised chestnuts & kabocha squash
recipe.why: Autumn brings chestnuts, winter squash, and game birds to the table.

tasks.title: Pre-boarding shopping in Dubrovnik: cash, snacks, alcohol, dietary items
Buy Disney tickets for the Sept 26-27 park days (party of 6)
Call the dermatologist to book the wart-removal appointment
Confirm the 4-kid passport packet is complete before the appointment

acts.line: Nothing scheduled, so a clear run at the cash, snacks, and provisions to lay in before the boat.
Still open on the calendar; the hours belong to the Cavtat transfers and the boarding confirmation while you're on shore.
One last quiet evening in Dubrovnik before the charter, with Saturday's 5 PM boarding the next fixed point.
